title: Benefit Duration and Unemployment Entry: Quasi-experimental Evidence for Austria
title_zh: 津贴期限与失业进入：奥地利的准实验证据
authors: Rudolf Winter-Ebmer, Jonas Jessen, Robin Jessen, Andrew C. Johnston, Ewa Gałecka-Burdziak 等
official: 官方在线 1996-12-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies the impact of a selective extension of unemployment benefit duration on the incidence of unemployment in Austria. As the new law applies only to elderly workers in certain regions of the country after June 1988, a quasi-experimental situation is created. Unemployment entry is found to rise by between four and eleven percentage points due to the new law. The findings are explained by a breach of an implicit contract; elderly workers receive wages above their marginal product in order to elicit higher effort. Dismissal of elderly workers is now easier because more generous unemployment insurance makes reputation loss for the firm less severe.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了奥地利失业救济金期限选择性延长对失业发生率的影响。由于新法律仅适用于1988年6月后该国特定地区的老年工人，由此形成了准实验情境。研究发现，新法律导致失业率上升了4至11个百分点。这一结果可通过隐性契约的破裂来解释：老年工人获得高于其边际产出的工资以激励其付出更高努力。如今解雇老年工人变得更为容易，因为更慷慨的失业保险降低了企业声誉损失的严重程度。

title: Investment Prices and Exchange Rates: Some Basic Facts
title_zh: 投资价格与汇率：一些基本事实
authors: Sergio Rebelo, Joao C Neves, Ariel Burstein, Inmaculada C. Álvarez, Javier Barbero 等
official: 官方在线 2004-03-23 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This Paper documents four basic facts about investment goods and investment prices. First, investment has a very significant non-tradable component in the form of construction services. Second, distributions services (wholesaling, retailing, and transportation) are much less important for investment than for consumption. Third, the import content of investment is much larger than that of consumption. Finally, in the aftermath of three large devaluations, the rate of exchange rate pass-through is, perhaps not surprisingly, highest for imported equipment and lowest for construction services.
abstract_zh: 本文记录了关于投资品与投资价格的四个基本事实。第一，投资中包含了以建筑服务形式存在的、非常显著的非贸易成分。第二，分销服务（批发、零售和运输）对投资的重要性远低于对消费的重要性。第三，投资的进口含量远高于消费的进口含量。最后，在三次大规模货币贬值之后，汇率传递程度——或许并不令人意外——在进口设备中最高，在建筑服务中最低。

title: Coarse Memory and Plausible Narratives
title_zh: 粗糙记忆与合理叙事
authors: Bilotta, Francesco, Manferdini, Giacomo
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Microeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We develop a dynamic model of narrative-based political competition. Voters recall the frequency of policies and outcomes, but not their correlation. Politicians exploit such coarse memory by crafting plausible narratives that overstate their policy’s effectiveness, reattributing outcomes to steal credit and shift blame. Because plausibility makes narrative optimism fall with policy implementation, incumbency erodes narrative advantage. This force generates endogenous policy cycles and, in the long run, makes tenure independent of true policy effectiveness. Extensions to analogy-based expectations, preferences for truth-telling, and heterogeneous voter feedback show how our mechanisms operate in richer settings that restore a role for policy effectiveness.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个基于叙事的政治竞争动态模型。选民能够回忆政策与结果的频率，但无法记住两者之间的相关性。政客利用这种粗粒度的记忆，通过编造看似合理的叙事来夸大其政策的有效性，重新归因结果以窃取功劳并推卸责任。由于叙事的合理性会随着政策实施而降低其乐观程度，执政地位会逐渐削弱叙事优势。这一机制催生了内生性政策周期，从长期来看，执政时长将独立于政策的真实有效性。通过拓展至基于类比的预期、偏好诚实陈述以及异质性选民反馈等情境，我们展示了上述机制如何在更丰富的设定中发挥作用，从而恢复政策有效性的作用。

title: Optimal Verification of (Mis)Information in Networks
title_zh: 网络中（错误）信息的最优验证
authors: L. Merlino, Nicole Tabasso
official: 官方在线 2026-07-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study the diffusion of a true and a false message (misinformation) when agents are biased and able to verify messages. As a recipient of a false message who verifies it becomes informed of the truth, a higher prevalence of misinformation can increase the prevalence of the truth. We uncover conditions such that this happens and discuss policy implications. Specifically, a planner aiming to maximize the prevalence of the truth should allow misinformation to circulate if: non-verified messages may be ignored, transmission of information is relatively low, and the planner's budget to induce verification is neither too low nor too high. Homophily increases the spread of misinformation, but also facilitates diffusion of truth, and leads to similar results on the effect of verification.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了当个体存在偏见且能够验证信息时，真实信息与虚假信息（错误信息）的传播机制。当接收虚假信息的个体通过验证获知真相时，错误信息的更高流行度反而可能提升真相的普及程度。我们揭示了此类现象发生的条件，并探讨其政策启示。具体而言，若规划者旨在最大化真相普及度，则应在以下情形允许错误信息传播：未经验证的信息可能被忽略、信息传播效率相对较低、且规划者用于诱导验证的预算既不过低也不过高。同质性虽会加剧错误信息的扩散，但同时也促进真相的传播，并对验证效果产生类似影响。

title: The Impact and Incidence of Supplemental Health Insurance: Evidence from Sweden
title_zh: 补充健康保险的影响与发生率：来自瑞典的证据
authors: Palme, Mårten, Seim, David, Spinnewijn, Johannes, Wikström, Jens
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies the role of private supplemental health insurance (SHI) in universal healthcare systems. Linking novel microdata on SHI contracts to rich administrative data from Sweden, we document a steep income gradient in take-up: higher-income individuals are substantially more likely to enroll in SHI despite a greater healthcare need among lower-income individuals. Exploiting variation in the timing of employer-sponsored SHI, we find large and persistent increases in healthcare utilization (23 percent). The effects are even larger for low-income individuals and extend beyond specialist consultations to high-value treatments, consistent with binding rationing in public care. Focusing on cancer as a high-stakes condition, we find that SHI increases screening and diagnoses and reduces mortality. Although SHI is privately contracted, its effects materialize largely within the public healthcare system: coverage increases publicly financed utilization and reduces waiting times, generating negative fiscal and congestion externalities.
abstract_zh: 本文研究私人补充医疗保险（SHI）在全民医疗体系中的作用。通过将瑞典新型SHI合同微观数据与丰富的行政数据相关联，我们发现参保率存在显著的收入梯度：尽管低收入群体医疗需求更大，但高收入个体参保SHI的可能性显著更高。利用雇主提供SHI的时间差异，我们发现医疗利用率出现大幅且持续的增长（23%）。这种效应在低收入群体中更为显著，且影响范围从专科门诊延伸至高价值治疗，这与公共医疗中的刚性配给机制一致。以癌症这一高风险疾病为例，我们发现SHI提高了筛查率和诊断率，并降低了死亡率。尽管SHI属于私人合同，但其效应主要显现在公共医疗体系内：参保增加了公共医疗资源的使用并缩短了等待时间，从而产生负面的财政和拥堵外部性。

title: e‐Globalization and trade agreements
title_zh: e-全球化与贸易协定
authors: Phillip McCalman
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The global success of online search and social media stems from free access and high quality—both enabled by a business model that monetizes personal data through targeted advertising. But does this model yield socially desirable outcomes? We examine how a global monopoly platform chooses privacy protection and service quality. Under a free‐service model, it overexploits data and underprovides quality relative to a global planner. Yet, even with distortions on both margins, stronger privacy protection alone can improve global welfare—and may even boost quality. When privacy policy is set nationally, large countries often align with global interests due to a “Brussels Effect,” where platform responses to one country's policy spill over globally. This alignment reduces the need for privacy rules in trade agreements. In contrast, ad tech taxes create “beggar‐thy‐neighbour” incentives, making them a clear case for international cooperation.
abstract_zh: 摘要 在线搜索与社交媒体的全球成功源于免费访问与高质量服务——这两者均得益于通过定向广告将个人数据货币化的商业模式。但这一模式能否产生符合社会期望的结果？我们研究了一家全球垄断平台在隐私保护与服务质量之间的权衡选择。在免费服务模式下，相较于全球规划者，该平台过度利用数据且服务质量不足。然而，即便在这两个维度均存在扭曲，仅加强隐私保护本身就能改善全球福利——甚至可能提升服务质量。当隐私政策由国家层面制定时，大国往往因"布鲁塞尔效应"与全球利益趋同，即平台对一国政策的反应会产生全球溢出效应。这种趋同降低了贸易协定中隐私规则的必要性。相比之下，广告技术税会催生"以邻为壑"的激励，使其成为国际合作的明确案例。

title: Social Insurance with Imperfect Eligibility Screening: Theory and Evidence from Pandemic UI
title_zh: 不完全资格筛查下的社会保险：理论与来自疫情失业救济的证据
authors: Adam Isen, Elira Kuka, Bryan A. Stuart
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper studies social insurance with imperfect eligibility screening, focusing on Unemployment Insurance (UI) during its expansion in 2020 and 2021. We study the extent of imperfect screening by identifying anomalous payments using administrative tax data and UI policies, finding $214 billion in potentially-improper payments—concentrated in the Pandemic Unemployment Assistance (PUA) program—with approximately half detectable ex-ante through improved federal-state data sharing. There is substantial geographic variation, and a border design shows this is partly due to policy decisions made by states. To assess the implications for optimal policy, we first conduct simulations that replace PUA with means-tested, lump-sum transfers, finding that these transfers would have better insured against income losses at lower administrative cost. Second, we develop a model of opt-in versus automatic transfers that shows the targeting advantage of opt-in programs can reverse when ineligible recipients pass the benefit screen. Calibrated to 2020 UI, the model implies that shifting toward automatic transfers would have increased social welfare.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了资格筛查不完善条件下的社会保险问题，重点关注2020至2021年失业保险（UI）扩张期间的情况。我们通过利用行政税务数据和失业保险政策识别异常支付，探究了筛查不完善的程度，发现存在2140亿美元的潜在不当支付——主要集中在疫情失业援助（PUA）项目中——其中约半数可通过改进联邦与州之间的数据共享实现事前检测。这些支付存在显著的地域差异，而边界设计分析表明，这在一定程度上源于各州制定的政策决策。为评估最优政策的影响，我们首先进行模拟，用基于经济状况调查的定额转移支付替代PUA项目，发现这些转移支付能以更低的行政成本更好地保障收入损失。其次，我们构建了一个选择性加入与自动转移支付模型，表明当不合格受助者通过福利筛查时，选择性加入项目的瞄准优势可能发生逆转。基于2020年失业保险数据的校准结果显示，转向自动转移支付本可提升社会福利。

title: All Clear for Takeoff: Evidence from Airports on the Effects of Infrastructure Privatization
title_zh: 基础设施私有化效应的机场证据：一切就绪，准备起飞
authors: Sabrina T Howell, Yeejin Jang, Hyeik Kim, Michael S Weisbach
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study privatization and corporate ownership in transportation infrastructure, focusing on global airports. Privatization in general does not improve performance. However, private equity (PE) ownership has strong and persistent positive effects on efficiency, volume, and quality, with positive externalities for the local economy. We address selection using close auctions where PE and non-PE firms bid. PE funds expand physical capacity and encourage larger planes while adding low-cost carriers and international routes. They are especially effective in countries with more corruption or state-owned flag carriers. In contrast, the poorer performance of non-PE acquirers may reflect private benefits and historical state ties.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究交通基础设施领域的私有化与企业所有权问题，重点关注全球机场。总体而言，私有化并未显著提升绩效。然而，私募股权（PE）所有权对效率、运力及服务质量具有持续且强劲的积极影响，并对当地经济产生正向外部效应。我们利用私募股权与非私募股权企业竞标的封闭式拍卖机制解决选择偏差问题。私募股权基金通过扩大物理容量、鼓励使用大型飞机，同时引入低成本航空公司及国际航线来提升运营表现。在腐败程度较高或存在国有旗舰航空公司的国家，私募股权的效果尤为显著。相比之下，非私募股权收购方的较差表现可能反映了其私人收益动机及历史性国有关联。

title: The Effect of Financial Resources on Fertility: Evidence from Administrative Data on Lottery Winners
title_zh: 金融资源对生育率的影响：基于彩票中奖者行政数据的证据
authors: Yung-Yu Tsai, Hsing-Wen Han, Kuang-Ta Lo, Tzu-Ting Yang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper utilizes wealth shocks from winning lottery prizes to examine the causal effect of financial resources on fertility. We employ extensive panels of administrative data encompassing over 0.4 million lottery winners in Taiwan and implement a triple-differences design. Our analyses reveal that a substantial lottery win can significantly increase fertility, the implied wealth elasticity of which is around 0.06. Moreover, the primary channel through which fertility increases is by prompting first births among previously childless individuals. Finally, our analysis reveals that approximately 25% of the total fertility effect stems from increased marriage rates following a lottery win.
abstract_zh: 本文利用中奖彩票带来的财富冲击，考察金融资源对生育率的因果效应。我们采用涵盖台湾地区超过40万彩票中奖者的广泛行政数据面板，并实施三重差分设计。分析表明，大额彩票中奖能显著提高生育率，其隐含的财富弹性约为0.06。此外，生育率提升的主要渠道是促使此前无子女的个体生育头胎。最后，我们的分析揭示，约25%的总生育效应源于中奖后结婚率的上升。

title: A Theory of Price Caps on Nonrenewable Resources
title_zh: 非可再生资源价格上限理论
authors: Simon Johnson, Lukasz Rachel, Catherine Wolfram
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: What is the optimal response of a resource exporter when a price cap is imposed on its main export? This paper develops a dynamic framework incorporating stochastic prices, financial frictions, and market power to study this novel tool of statecraft. With the right design, a price cap can incentivize increased extraction, stabilizing prices in the global market. But the stabilizing effects diminish when there is leakage outside the cap. Consequently, weak enforcement of the policy worsens the trade-off faced by the sanctioning policymaker. We provide a systematic approach to setting and enforcing an optimal cap level in these circumstances. (JEL F12, F14, F51, L71, P28, P33, Q35)
abstract_zh: 当资源出口国的主要出口产品被施加价格上限时，其最优应对策略是什么？本文构建了一个融合随机价格、金融摩擦与市场势力的动态分析框架，以研究这一新型国家治理工具。若设计得当，价格上限可激励出口国扩大开采规模，从而稳定全球市场价格。但当存在超出价格上限范围的漏出效应时，这种稳定作用将减弱。因此，制裁政策制定者面临的政策执行力度不足问题，会加剧其面临的权衡困境。我们针对此类情形，提出了一套设定并执行最优价格上限水平的系统性方法。（JEL分类号：F12, F14, F51, L71, P28, P33, Q35）

title: The Dynamic Effects of Cash Transfers to Agricultural Households
title_zh: 现金转移对农业家庭动态效应
authors: Shilpa Aggarwal, Jenny C. Aker, Dahyeon Jeong, Naresh Kumar, David Sungho Park 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Little is known about the evolution and persistence of the effects of one-time cash transfers, especially in rural agricultural settings with limited productive investment opportunities. We use bimonthly phone surveys to estimate dynamic impacts for cash transfer recipients in Liberia and Malawi. We find immediate increases in food security that attenuate over time but do not entirely dissipate even 1.5–2 years later, driven by increased farm investments and production. We find increases in farm profits, reductions in casual off-farm labor, improvements in psychological well-being, and, in Liberia, a reduction in intimate partner violence (IPV). (JEL I31, I32, J43, O12, O13, Q12)
abstract_zh: 关于一次性现金转移效应的演变与持续性，尤其是在农村农业环境中有限的生产性投资机会下，我们知之甚少。我们利用双月电话调查，估算利比里亚和马拉维现金转移接受者的动态影响。研究发现，粮食安全立即改善，但随时间推移逐渐减弱，即使在1.5至2年后也未完全消失，这主要源于农业投资和生产的增加。我们还观察到农业利润上升、非农临时劳动减少、心理健康改善，以及在利比里亚，亲密伴侣暴力（IPV）减少。（JEL I31, I32, J43, O12, O13, Q12）

title: Paying More and Buying Less: 2025 Tariffs and U.S. Household Spending
title_zh: 多付少买：2025年关税与美国居民消费
authors: Sinem Hacıoğlu Hoke, Leo Feler
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper estimates the effects of the 2025 U.S. tariffs on household spending using transaction-level data linked to tariff exposure and a tariff sentiment survey. Comparing high versus low tariff-exposed categories, we find 15 to 20 percent price pass-through. At the mean increase in tariff exposure, prices rise by 1 to 2 percent while spending falls by roughly 4 percent. Survey evidence linking stated intentions to revealed behavior identifies a mechanism for the large spending response: reallocation toward essentials and trade-down within categories, concentrated among middle-income households with discretionary slack who express tariff concerns. Low-income households bear a disproportionate welfare burden through regressive pass-through.
abstract_zh: 本文利用与关税暴露度相关联的交易级数据及关税情绪调查，估算了2025年美国关税对家庭支出的影响。通过比较高关税暴露度与低关税暴露度的商品类别，我们发现价格传导率为15%至20%。在关税暴露度平均增幅下，价格上涨1%至2%，而支出下降约4%。将调查中陈述的意图与揭示的行为相联系的证据，识别出了支出大幅变动的机制：向必需品重新配置以及类别内的降级消费，这一现象集中在拥有可自由支配空间且表达关税担忧的中等收入家庭。低收入家庭则通过累退性传导承担了不成比例的福利负担。

title: Recommendations to Reform the National Electricity Market (NEM)
title_zh: 改革国家电力市场（NEM）的建议
authors: Tim Nelson, Paula Conboy, Ava Hancock, Phil Hirschhorn
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-06-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Australia's National Electricity Market (NEM) was established in the late 1990s. The market is an energy only gross pool with zonal (state‐based) pricing. Over the past 15 years, the system has undergone a profound transformation as large coal‐fired power stations have retired and substantial volumes of large‐scale and embedded behind the meter variable renewables have been installed. In this context, Australian governments commissioned a review into the NEM by an expert panel (the ‘NEM Review’). This article provides a summary of the key findings of the Panel across three key timeframes: the short‐term market (spot market) is largely fit for purpose but ‘hidden participants’ are impeding efficient outcomes and there are increasing risks to be managed as the system becomes more weather dependant; the medium‐term derivative market, used to manage risk, requires urgent attention to ensure liquidity and price transparency facilitate efficient management of spot price risk; and a new long‐term integrated market mechanism designed to overcome the ‘tenor gap’ should be introduced to facilitate long‐term investment.
abstract_zh: 澳大利亚国家电力市场（NEM）成立于20世纪90年代末。该市场是一个仅含能源的集中式现货市场，采用区域（州级）定价机制。过去15年间，随着大型燃煤电厂退役以及大规模集中式与分布式表后可变可再生能源的并网，该电力系统经历了深刻变革。在此背景下，澳大利亚政府委托专家小组对NEM进行审查（即"NEM审查"）。本文总结了该小组在三个关键时间维度的主要发现：短期市场（现货市场）基本满足运行需求，但"隐性参与者"阻碍了效率提升，且随着系统对天气依赖性增强，需管理的风险日益增加；用于风险管理的衍生品中期市场亟需关注，以确保流动性和价格透明度能够有效管理现货价格风险；应引入旨在克服"期限缺口"的新型长期一体化市场机制，以促进长期投资。

title: Managing Excess Demand for Primary Care: Evidence from Online Experiments
title_zh: 管理初级医疗超额需求：来自在线实验的证据
authors: Diya Abraham, Ondrej Krcal, Jonathan Stäbler
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Primary healthcare systems in many developed countries are under strain, partly due to unrestricted patient demand. In response, policymakers have introduced measures to curb unnecessary GP visits, including (i) instituting a small upfront fee for GP visits, (ii) implementing a self-report based triage system, and (iii) providing more information to patients about their condition before they make an appointment with their GP. We evaluate the effectiveness of these approaches using two online experiments with a representative sample of UK adults. The first experiment involves induced monetary incentives in a laboratory-style study while the second is a health-framed vignette study. We find that while all three interventions are effective in the laboratory study, only the intervention that provides patients with more information about their condition reduces low-priority demand in the vignette study. We discuss implications for policy and for the study of health-related decision-making.
abstract_zh: 许多发达国家的初级医疗体系正面临压力，部分原因在于患者不受限制的就诊需求。为此，政策制定者引入了多项措施以减少不必要的全科医生就诊，包括：（i）对全科医生就诊收取小额预付费用；（ii）实施基于自我报告的分诊系统；（iii）在患者预约全科医生前，为其提供更多关于自身病情的相关信息。我们通过两项针对英国成年人群体的代表性样本在线实验，评估了这些方法的有效性。第一项实验采用实验室式研究中的诱导性货币激励，第二项实验则是以健康情境为框架的案例研究。研究发现，在实验室研究中，三种干预措施均有效；但在案例研究中，只有为患者提供更多病情信息的干预措施能减少低优先级就诊需求。我们讨论了这些发现对政策制定及健康相关决策研究的启示。

title: Trade and U.S. Inequality in the Tokyo Round
title_zh: 东京回合中的贸易与美国不平等
authors: Andrew Greenland, James Lake, John Lopresti
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Against a backdrop of sharply rising inequality, the Tokyo Round of the GATT resulted in a 1.6 percentage point reduction in average US tariffs – larger than CUSFTA, NAFTA, and the liberalization accompanying the granting of PNTR to China. We construct a novel IV based on the so-called “Swiss formula” that governed the Tokyo Round tariff liberalization to provide evidence of its effects on imports and inequality. Instrumented tariff reductions explain approximately 20% of the rise in income inequality between non-production and production workers between 1979 and 1988. This effect is largest among women, workers in routine occupations, and workers in more technology-intensive industries, suggesting a complementarity between trade liberalization and skill-biased technological change.
abstract_zh: 在收入不平等急剧加剧的背景下，关贸总协定东京回合使美国平均关税降低了1.6个百分点——这一降幅大于美加自由贸易协定、北美自由贸易协定以及给予中国永久正常贸易关系地位时的贸易自由化幅度。我们基于指导东京回合关税自由化的所谓"瑞士公式"构建了一个新的工具变量，以证明其对进口和不平等的影响。工具变量估计的关税削减解释了1979年至1988年间非生产工人与生产工人之间收入不平等上升的约20%。这一效应在女性、从事常规职业的工人以及技术密集型行业的工人中最为显著，表明贸易自由化与技能偏向型技术进步之间存在互补性。

title: Measuring Bias in Job Recommender Systems: Auditing the Algorithms
title_zh: 工作推荐系统中的偏见测量：算法审计
authors: Zhang, Shuo, Kuhn, Peter
official: 官方在线 2026-05-04 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We use an algorithm audit of China's four largest job boards to measure the causal effect of a job seeker's gender on the jobs that are recommended to them, and to identify the algorithmic processes that generate those recommendations. Focusing on identical male and female worker profiles seeking jobs in the same industry-occupation cell, we find precisely estimated but modest amounts of gender bias: Jobs recommended to women pay 0.2 percent less, request 0.9 percent less experience, come from smaller firms, and contain .07 standard deviations more stereotypically female content such as requests for patience, carefulness, and beauty. The dominant driver of these gender gaps is content-based matching between posted job ads and the declared gender in new workers' resumes. 'Action-based' mechanisms -based on a worker's own actions or recruiters' reactions to their resume- contribute relatively little to the gaps we measure.
abstract_zh: 我们通过对中国四大招聘平台的算法审计，测量求职者性别对推荐岗位的因果效应，并识别产生这些推荐的算法过程。聚焦于在同一行业-职业单元中求职的男女工人档案（特征完全相同），我们发现了精确估计但程度适中的性别偏差：推荐给女性的岗位薪资低0.2%，经验要求低0.9%，来自规模较小的企业，且包含多0.07个标准差的刻板女性化内容（如要求耐心、细心、美貌）。这些性别差距的主要驱动因素是招聘广告与新人简历中声明的性别之间的基于内容的匹配。基于工人自身行为或招聘方对其简历反应的"行动型"机制，对我们所测量的差距贡献相对较小。

title: Decentralization, Ethnic Fractionalization, and Public Services: Evidence from Kenyan Healthcare
title_zh: 分权、民族分裂与公共服务：来自肯尼亚医疗保健的证据
authors: Camille Hémet, Liam Wren-Lewis, Jessica Mahoney
official: 官方在线 2023-04-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines the impact of ethnic fractionalization on public service use by exploiting a major constitutional reform in Kenya. Following an important period of inter-ethnic conflict, responsibility for local health services was decentralized to 47 newly created county governments. Using an event-study design, we find that use of public clinics for births increased significantly after the reform, but only in counties that were relatively ethnically homogeneous. We also find a significant increase in the correlation between county ethnic fractionalization and a range of other measures of public health service use. Services in these counties are also less likely to require payments after decentralization. Using within-county variation to investigate mechanisms, we find healthcare use increases were concentrated among areas and individuals of the same ethnicity as members of the new county government executives. Overall, the results suggest that more ethnically homogeneous sub-national jurisdictions can rapidly increase public service use.
abstract_zh: 本文利用肯尼亚一次重大宪法改革，考察了民族分裂程度对公共服务使用的影响。在经历了一段重要的民族间冲突时期后，地方卫生服务责任被下放至47个新成立的县级政府。通过事件研究设计，我们发现改革后公立诊所用于分娩的使用率显著增加，但仅出现在民族相对同质的县。我们还发现，县级民族分裂程度与一系列其他公共卫生服务使用指标之间的相关性显著增强。权力下放后，这些县的服务也更少需要付费。利用县内差异探究机制，我们发现医疗保健使用率的增长集中在与新任县级政府行政人员同属一个民族的地区和个人中。总体而言，研究结果表明，民族更为同质的地方行政辖区能够迅速提高公共服务使用率。
